items.headline: $ONDO Jumps 20% on BlackRock Portfolio Tokens
items.summary: Ondo launched three onchain portfolio tokens built on BlackRock-designed strategies, live on Ethereum and BNB Chain. $ONDO rallied over 20% overnight, leading the altcoin bid.

items.headline: $FRAX Brings sfrxETH to Robinhood Chain
items.summary: Frax Finance confirmed its staked ETH token sfrxETH is now live on the newly launched Robinhood Chain, expanding $FRAX's reach into the retail-focused L2 ecosystem.

items.headline: $GEAR Teams With Frax for RWA Leverage Market
items.summary: Gearbox and Frax are launching a real-world-asset leverage market, a fresh DeFi use case letting users loop RWA yield. A notable new primitive for $GEAR holders to watch.

items.headline: $ARB Overhauls MEV With Per-Tx Priority Auctions
items.summary: Arbitrum replaced Timeboost with per-transaction priority auctions, routing 97% of priority fees to the DAO treasury. A major tokenomics-adjacent upgrade for $ARB.

items.headline: $HIFI Raises $37M for Tokenized Capital Markets
items.summary: HIFI closed a $37M Series A led by Left Lane Capital to scale its tokenized settlement infrastructure, one of the bigger recent raises in the RWA altcoin space.
